declarations.description:
A read-only project timeline: tasks as bars on a day, week or month scale, with progress, groups that span
their children, milestones, finish-to-start dependency arrows and a line for today. A task list sits on the
left and stays put while the timeline scrolls sideways; below 560px of width it gives way to a compact layout
with each label above its bar.

Tasks come in one of two ways. Give `tasks` an array (or a JSON attribute) for data from an API, or write
`c2-gantt-task` elements inside the chart, nested to form groups, for markup. When `tasks` holds an array it
wins and the children are ignored.

Dates are calendar days (`YYYY-MM-DD`), and `end` is inclusive. Weeks start on the locale's first day of the
week (`locale`, the page's `lang`, or the browser's language) unless `week-start` says otherwise, and the
locale's weekend is shaded.

The chart is a tree grid: each row is focusable, ↑ and ↓ move between rows, → and ← open and close groups,
Enter selects. Each row's accessible name gives the task's dates, length, progress and predecessors.

members.name: tasks
members.description:
The tasks, as an array or a JSON attribute. `null` (the default) reads the `c2-gantt-task` children instead;
an array wins over them. Assign a new array to change the data.

members.name: scale
members.description: Zoom level: `day`, `week` or `month`.

members.name: start
members.description: First visible day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to the tasks' first day, snapped to the scale.

members.name: end
members.description: Last visible day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Defaults to the tasks' last day, snapped to the scale.

members.name: today
members.description: Where the today line goes: absent for the current date, a `YYYY-MM-DD` day to pin it, `false` to hide it.

members.name: selected
members.description: Id of the selected task.

members.name: collapsed
members.description: Ids of the closed groups, separated by `;` in the attribute.

members.name: hideList
members.description: Leaves the task list out and labels the bars instead. The rows stay available to assistive technology.

members.name: layout
members.description: `split` keeps the task list, `compact` puts each label above its bar, `auto` picks compact below 560px.

members.name: locale
members.description: Language of the dates and of the default week start. Defaults to the page's `lang`, then the browser's.

members.name: weekStart
members.description: First day of the week: `locale`, `monday` … `sunday`, or an ISO number (1 is Monday, 7 is Sunday).

members.name: weekend
members.description: ISO weekdays to shade, such as `6 7`. Absent follows the locale; an empty value shades nothing.

members.name: loading
members.description: Shows placeholder rows while the tasks load.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the chart.

members.name: renderTooltip
members.description: Replaces the tooltip's contents. Return anything Lit renders, or `null` for no tooltip. Property only.

members.name: renderLabel
members.description: Replaces a task's text in the list. Property only.

members.name: keyboardFocus
members.description: The tooltip follows the focus only while the keyboard is driving.

members.name: #hydrating
members.description:
Upgrading over server-rendered markup. The server cannot read the task children, so it rendered an empty frame;
the first client render must match it or Lit's hydration throws, and the timeline fills in on the update after.

members.name: #collectMarkup
members.description: Builds `GanttTaskConfig`s from the child elements: nesting makes the parent, wrappers are looked through.

members.name: #measure
members.description: Resolves the CSS column width and row height to pixels, and tracks the host width for `layout="auto"`.

members.name: #activate
members.description: A click or Enter on a task: `task-click`, then the selection unless that was cancelled.

members.name: #currentFocus
members.description: The row holding the roving tabindex: the focused one, else the selected one, else the first.

members.name: #placeTooltip
members.description:
Shows the tooltip and puts it under its row (above when the viewport has no room below), starting a little into
the bar and kept inside the visible part of the timeline and the viewport. Fixed coordinates: the popover lives in the top layer.

members.name: #schedulePlaceTooltip
members.description: Scroll and resize fire in bursts; one placement per frame is enough.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user selects a task. `detail.value` is its id. Does not bubble.

events.name: group-toggle
events.description: Fired after the user opens or closes a group. `collapsed` already holds the new state. Does not bubble.

events.name: task-hover
events.description: Fired when the pointer moves onto a bar, or off the bars (with nulls). Does not bubble.
Fired when a bar or a row is clicked, or Enter is pressed on a row, before the selection changes. Cancel it to keep the selection as it is. Bubbles.

declarations.name: GANTT_TASK_CHANGE_EVENT
declarations.description: Fired at the parent chart whenever a task definition changes. Not public API.

One task of a `c2-gantt`, declared in markup. The element renders nothing: it is a definition the chart reads,
the way `c2-chart-series` is for a chart. A task nested inside another task is that task's child, so the
markup is the tree:

```html
<c2-gantt>
  <c2-gantt-task task-id="design" label="Design">
    <c2-gantt-task task-id="ia" start="2026-09-28" end="2026-10-02">Information architecture</c2-gantt-task>
    <c2-gantt-task start="2026-10-05" end="2026-10-16" dependencies="ia">Visual design</c2-gantt-task>
  </c2-gantt-task>
</c2-gantt>
```

The label is the `label` attribute, or the element's own text when there is none. Wrapper elements between
tasks (an Astro island, a template's container) are looked through.

members.name: taskId
members.description: Id other tasks name in `dependencies`. Falls back to the element's `id`, then to a generated key.

members.name: label
members.description: Text in the task list, the bar and the tooltip. Falls back to the element's own text.

members.name: start
members.description: First day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Ignored on a task with children, whose span is theirs.

members.name: end
members.description: Last day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive. Omitted means a one-day task.

members.name: progress
members.description: Share of the work done, from 0 to 1.

members.name: milestone
members.description: Draws the task as a diamond on its `start` day.

members.name: dependencies
members.description: Ids of the tasks that must finish first, separated by spaces.

members.name: tone
members.description: `primary`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `neutral`, or a palette slot from `1` to `8`.

members.name: resolvedId
members.description: The id the chart knows this task by.

members.name: #ownText
members.description: This element's own text, leaving out the text of nested tasks.

members.name: toTask
members.description: A plain snapshot of this definition, so the chart never holds on to the element.
